page_title: EIN 0-0 FRE | Eintracht Frankfurt v Freiburg 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' The goal by Junior Adamu (Freiburg) won't count as it has been disallowed on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+6' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) scores a goal, but Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
90+5' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Junior Adamu (Freiburg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
90+2' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) flashes a in volley from just outside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post. The goalkeeper can stay calm.
90+1' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and it's Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Freiburg are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
86' It's like he was asking for a caution. Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) receives a yellow card.
86' Kevin Trapp (Eintracht Frankfurt) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
86' The yellow card is received by Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt).
84' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Lucas Holer is replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
84' The game has come to an end for Lukas Kubler. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kenneth Schmidt (Freiburg).
83' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

82' Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
80' Substitution. Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Fares Chaibi.
80' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Niels Nkounkou.
79' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is hurriedly cleared.
79' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
79' Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Zwayer blows for a foul.
77' The attendance for today's match is 55000.
77' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away.
74' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Ritsu Doan and he is replaced by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincenzo Grifo departs the field of play to be replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
71' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
65' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Buta.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Omar Marmoush walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.

60' Nice move, nice attempt! Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
58' Substitution. Junior Dina Ebimbe did his best and is replaced by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
56' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt manage to earn a corner.
54' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Kevin Trapp makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
52' William Joel Pacho Tenorio (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
50' The linesman raises his flag. Roland Sallai (Freiburg) is adjudged offside.

46' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Noah Atubolu pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Relief for Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

45+4' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt), but referee Felix Zwayer must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
45+2' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is flagged for offside.
45' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

44' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Freiburg.
42' PENALTY APPEAL after Roland Sallai (Freiburg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
38' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
38' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is able to continue to play.
36' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
35' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
33' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
32' Dangerous play by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt). Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.

31' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley directed low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
30' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
28' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a cross from the corner, but Noah Atubolu is alert to thwart the effort.

28' A lofted cross from Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
26' A pass from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Noah Atubolu and the move breaks down.
24' The corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared away by the defence.
24' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
21' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
20' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
19' The ball is cleared after Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

15' Freiburg are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
12' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
12' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
12' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Eintracht Frankfurt.

11' Noah Atubolu makes a good save! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) easily weaves through the defence and fires in from long range. His shot goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
10' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

4' Kevin Trapp pulls off a brilliant save! Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. The ball goes out for a corner. Freiburg can continue in their attacking effort.
3' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
Felix Zwayer got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
